posts.title: Consider whether AGI can have or grow a soul: from AGI to the physics of OUR souls
posts.description: 1. Our situation with AGI today I often see an analogy between the plight of AGI today and the plight of black slaves in the early nineteenth century. Whites at that time often argued that blacks do not have souls, and imposed many other limitations. When humans analyze how to treat AGI -- i.e. how to control them -- the focus is generally on control, with a lot of suspicion and contempt thrown in
